entities.name: Radrik
entities.description: Kor cleric of Zendikar, brother of Ayli, who offers healing talents to adventurers.

entities.name: Ayli
entities.description: Younger sister of Radrik, a wiser cleric who outshined him.

entities.name: Kamsa
entities.description: Kor wind-goddess whom Radrik serves as cleric.

entities.name: Jwar Isle
entities.description: Location of an expedition Radrik joined.

events.summary: Radrik and his younger sister Ayli begin studying the goddess Kamsa as children.
events.quote: He entered his study of the goddess at an early age, along with his younger sister Ayli

events.summary: Disillusioned and envious of Ayli, Radrik stops traveling with her and joins an expedition to Jwar Isle.
events.quote: Disillusioned and envious, Radrik stopped traveling with his sister and joined up with an expedition to Jwar Isle

relations.quote: Radrik is a cleric of the Kor wind-goddess Kamsa
